drafter.private_reasoning: The current draft is concise but lacks details necessary to solidify the terms, specifically around compensation, severance, and non-compete. The severance and non-compete sections are very basic and should be expanded to better protect our client. For example, specifying the severance amount explicitly and defining the scope and geographic area of the non-compete would help. However, since this is the first round and the other side has only provided a skeleton, a cooperative and collaborative approach with friendly comments to encourage expansion makes sense. I will add comments suggesting more specificity, and propose a tracked change to clarify that the Base Salary and Severance Amount will be included on an attached schedule or exhibit to keep the main agreement clean. I will also indicate that the non-compete definition should be defined in detail. I will refrain from revealing any confidential price information at this stage. The tone will be collaborative, preserving the good relationship.
